# Eventive

> > Eventive is a virtual cinema and streaming platform dedicated to independent film festivals and documentary screenings worldwide.

The platform hosts virtual editions of film festivals including Oxford Virtual Film Festival, Maine Jewish Film Festival, and Out on Film Festival, offering video-on-demand access to independent films, documentaries, and short film competitions with interactive voting features.

## Key Topics

- Virtual film screenings
- Independent film festivals
- Documentary films
- Short film competitions
- Oxford Virtual Film Festival
- Maine Jewish Film Festival
- Out on Film Festival
- Artist Vodka voting competitions
- Video-on-demand streaming
- LGBTQ+ cinema
- Horror shorts programming
- Festival programming blocks
- Online film distribution
- Film festival partnerships

## Platform Overview

- [Eventive | Discover & watch independent film](https://watch.eventive.org): Homepage for Eventive streaming platform featuring indie films & festivals

## Feature Documentaries

- [Far East Deep South | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e954b4854d2f50029a46dca/5e17d928161e39015867b58d): Documentary on Chinese-American history in segregated Mississippi
- [Rosenwald | Maine Jewish Film Festival Weekend Edition](https://watch.eventive.org/2021mjffweekend/play/60106b5dd751cc0091aca1c2): Documentary on Julius Rosenwald's schools for African Americans
- [Last Stop Coney Island: The Life and Photography of Harold Feinstein | First Virtual Maine Jewish Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020mjff/play/5f57c4e25cb1a20074b05e21): Documentary on photographer Harold Feinstein at Maine Jewish Film Festival
- [State of the Unity | Big Water Week Five | 15th BIG WATER FILM FESTIVAL](https://watch.eventive.org/15thbigwaterfilmfestival/play/63768b032c146e0ce0f52b10/6367cd10b830e1004537ddc7): Music doc following The Bergamot's 50-state tour during 2016 election

## Artist Vodka Voting Competitions

- [As Advised | Artist Vodka Block #1 - Watch and Vote!  | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e951e1dd74a840031075a53/5e175d7188a5bd0031b9c262): Dystopian short in Artist Vodka voting competition at Oxford fest
- [The Comedian | Artist Vodka Block #1 - Watch and Vote!  | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e951e1dd74a840031075a53/5e176d8488a5bd0031b9c637): Indian Bollywood short in Artist Vodka Block voting competition
- [The Rougarou | Artist Vodka Block #1 - Watch and Vote!  | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e951e1dd74a840031075a53/5e1779d790dd800029220e92): Short film in Artist Vodka voting competition at Oxford festival
- [...so it goes | Artist Vodka Block #1 - Watch and Vote!  | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e951e1dd74a840031075a53/5e18eb853fc1cd00313a93fe): Experimental film-poem in Artist Vodka voting block at Oxford fest
- [Mother's Day | Artist Vodka Block #1 - Watch and Vote!  | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e951e1dd74a840031075a53/5e18edab3a074800296f17d7): 1968-period short in Artist Vodka voting competition at Oxford fest

## Horror & Genre Programming

- [TONIGHT IT'S YOU | Horror Shorts for Halloween  | 2020 Out on Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020ooff/play/5f9079c0ba6bfe0094aa7a91): LGBT horror short at Out on Film Festival's Halloween program
- [CLEANSE | Horror Shorts for Halloween  | 2020 Out on Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020ooff/play/5f9079c0ba6bfe0094aa7a91/5f907e25b3938d0107040af1): Horror short about pranic healing at LGBTQ festival Halloween block
- [A Stranger Among The Living | 2020 Oxford Virtual Film Festival](https://watch.eventive.org/2020oxff/play/5e8fcb91773343002a2dbc1b/5e17e872bbeb930182f19332): Supernatural horror-thriller about school shooting premonition
